# The WGSL batch rows (S10 B4b item 5b, ruling Q-S10-r9: a stored table).
# A C generator (batchgen.c, outside the repo, linked with src/front) made
# this file one time from fixed seeds: thr_hash over a tag and the row
# index. test/gate.sh gives the rows of each entry of test/wgsl/batch.lang
# to build/wasmtool and to build/wgsltool and compares the two outputs.
# A ballot is 3 rows. A `sigOk k r z m yx yy` row is a Schnorr signature
# (k, r, z) on the head m and the entry hash(yx, yy). The rows
# `or0Ok yx yy a0x a0y a1x c0 c1 z0` and `or1Ok yx yy a1x a1y c1 z1` are an
# OR proof that Y = (yx, yy) is x G (ballot i even) or x G + G (i odd).
# Ballot 37 has z1 + 1, so its or1Ok output is 0. The other 191 rows give 1.
# A linkOk row is `linkOk parent payload claimed`: 1024 links of a hash
# chain from parent 0, with payload j at link j. Link 700 shows the
# payload 1000700 with the claimed word of payload 700, so its output is 0.
# The other 1023 links give 1.
